hardness.label: Very Hard
hardness.intro: New Braunfels Utilities (NBU) reported an average of 15.1 GPG in its 2018 water quality report. Click a neighbourhood to see what that means for your home.
hardness.reportNote: NBU's 2018 water quality report gave a citywide average of 15.1 GPG, within a range of 8.1 to 19.5 GPG. The Water Quality Association classes anything above 10.5 GPG as "Very Hard." [VERIFY current NBU average]
hardness.footnote: Hardness is NBU's citywide figure from its 2018 report; individual neighbourhoods can read higher or lower. [VERIFY current NBU average]
